items.title: JLR to raise 2 billion loan from global banks to refinance debt
items.summary: At the end of FY26, JLR had 5.4 billion of debt outstanding, comprising 1.8 billion of unsecured bonds, 2.9 billion of unsecured loans and 38 million of other debt, according to the company’s annual report.

items.summary: JK Tyre & Industries reported an 83 percent year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit for the fourth quarter of FY2026 and announced a Rs 4,980 crore capacity expansion programme for truck, bus and passenger car radial tyres as it prepares for rising domestic demand. items.title: Nissan inks deal to make Chery's UK vehicles at Sunderland facility
items.summary: Japanese automaker Nissan has struck a deal with Chinese manufacturer Chery. Nissan will produce Chery's UK passenger cars at its Sunderland factory. This partnership aims to boost Chery's European presence and avoid import duties. The move is part of Nissan's strategy to optimize its plant usage and cut costs.

items.title: Toyota launches refreshed Innova Crysta with updated styling; price starts at ₹19.72 lakh
items.summary: The company has additionally introduced a wireless charger and tyre pressure monitoring system (TPMS) to improve convenience and safety.

items.title: Tata Motors targets 20% PV market share by 2030: Chairman Chandrasekaran
items.summary: Addressing the company's dealer business planning meet 2026 in Goa, N Chandrasekaran said the automaker has already committed ₹35,000 crore in capital expenditure through 2030 and could recalibrate investment plans as market conditions evolve.

items.title: RSB Transmissions acquires Setco Auto Systems to strengthen commercial vehicle components business
items.summary: The acquisition expands RSB's footprint in the automotive components sector and adds clutch systems to its portfolio of drivetrain products.

items.title: Atul Auto, Exponent Energy partner to roll out 15-minute charging electric three-wheelers
items.summary: The tie-up will integrate 15-minute rapid charging technology into factory-built vehicles, aiming to accelerate EV adoption in the commercial segment.

items.title: Tata Motors rethinks its premium EV playbook
items.summary: Tata Motors has revamped its premium EV brand, Avinya, by shifting from its original platform plans to leveraging partnerships and ready-made architectures. This strategic pivot aims to accelerate the launch of its luxury EVs, with the first model slated for a 2027 India rollout, utilizing the Freelander platform from Chery Jaguar Land Rover.

items.title: Tata Motors turns to Chery platform for Avinya EVs after JLR roadmap setback
items.summary: The first Avinya model based on Chery's platform is expected to be launched in 2027, with a second model planned for 2029.

items.summary: The automaker said it plans to launch two new models from its Chennai plant this year, including its first mass-market dedicated EV.

items.title: PV sales stay resilient in May despite fuel price hike; Maruti, Mahindra and Tata lead the pack
items.summary: Industry clocks around 4.4 lakh units in May as strong demand for CNG vehicles and EVs helps offset concerns over rising fuel prices and geopolitical uncertainty.

items.title: TVS Srichakra Approves Rs 220 Crore Capex for Capacity Expansion at Madurai Plants
items.summary: The board of directors of TVS Srichakra Limited has approved a capital investment of up to Rs 220 crore to expand production capacities at its manufacturing facilities located in Vellaripatti, Madurai. The decision was finalized during a board meeting on May 27, 2026, according to a regulatory filing submitted to the stock exchanges.

items.title: Amara Raja plans ₹1,700 crore capex push for FY27; targets Q1 FY28 lithium plant launch
items.summary: The lead acid battery manufacturer through its new energy business unit, Amara Raja Advanced Technologies, is targeting a total cell manufacturing capacity of 16GWh in a phased manner by 2030.

items.title: Tata AutoComp forms JV with Korea’s Jahwa Electronics for EV heater systems
items.summary: T​he joint venture will position India as a strategic manufacturing and supply hub for Jahwa Electronics, leveraging growing demand for electrified mobility solutions in the country.

items.summary: Tata AutoComp Systems Limited has entered into a joint venture agreement with South Korea based Jahwa Electronics to locally manufacture and supply advanced thermal management solutions for the Indian automotive market. items.title: JK Tyre Unveils One Of Its Largest Capex Plans As Capacity Utilisation Crosses 90%
items.summary: JK Tyre & Industries Ltd has announced one of its largest-ever capital expenditure plans, approving a Rs 4,980 crore phased expansion of its truck and passenger car radial tyre capacities amid strong demand across domestic and export markets. The expansion, approved by the company’s board, will increase overall capacity by 24% over the next three years and will primarily focus on the Chennai and Mysore plants.

items.title: Govt set to roll out ₹3,000-crore incentive scheme for lithium, nickel processing to boost EV supply chain
items.summary: To qualify for the proposed incentives, lithium processing facilities are expected to require a minimum annual capacity of 30,000 metric tonnes, while nickel processing plants would need a minimum capacity of 50,000 metric tonnes.

items.title: Clean rules put auto parts cos on a whole new growth path
items.summary: Even as geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruptions create near-term volatility, industry executives said the regulatory cycle—spanning fuel efficiency, emissions, safety and electrification—is broader than earlier ones and is expected to increase the value of components fitted in every vehicle.
